title: Full-text screening ADJUDICATION — structured output (v1, D's resolution of the 39 B/C conflicts)
description: No $ref/$defs/maxLength (codex strict-schema requirement); additionalProperties:false on every object; every property listed in required. scripts/ft_adjudicate_run.py validates the returned JSON against this schema with one repair retry. Adjudicator D: independent third read of the full text, deciding a conflict between reviewers B and C.

record_id.description: Echo of the input record_id exactly as supplied.

final_disposition.description: D's own independent disposition, decided from the full text against the binding rules, not by majority or reviewer confidence.

final_primary_code.description: Non-empty if and only if final_disposition is EXCLUDE; the first established reason in hierarchy order. "" otherwise.

decisive_evidence.description: Format: p.N: "<=25-word verbatim quote" -- the single most decisive passage behind final_disposition, or "" only for NOT_RETRIEVED with unreadable text.

which_reviewer_matched.description: Whether D's own independent final_disposition matches B's final disposition, C's final disposition, or neither (decided only after D's own answer is reached).

n_bouts_sampled.description: For final_disposition INCLUDE_A/INCLUDE_B/INCLUDE_A_AND_B: the number of distinct, identifiable exercise bouts the eligible cohort was sampled around (e.g. "1", "2", "4"), with a short qualifier if useful (e.g. "3 (weekly races)"). "not_applicable" for every other disposition.

baseline_comparator_present.description: For final_disposition INCLUDE_A/INCLUDE_B/INCLUDE_A_AND_B: whether a pre-bout baseline or suitable non-exercise comparator exists for the included stream(s). "not_applicable" for every other disposition.

D_note.description: <=35 words. States which rule clause decides the case (FT code, PRE-011 branch, Core A vs Support B test, RETAIN_BACKGROUND failed dimension, or the missing fact for AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION).

note.description: <=30 words, free text, no personal data, no e-mail. Anything else useful for the human adjudicator checking this work (e.g. OCR noise, cohort linkage, translation concern, a rule clause that felt ambiguous).
